b_max_x.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction
b_max_x.description: Maximum borehole-to-borehole spacing in x-direction. Units: meters (m).

b_max_y.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction
b_max_y.description: Maximum borehole-to-borehole spacing in y-direction. Units: meters (m).

borehole_removal_method.title: Borehole removal method
borehole_removal_method.description: Defines the method used to remove boreholes from a borefield. This is planned to be an optional parameter for multiple borefield design methods.

conductivity.title: Thermal conductivity
conductivity.description: Thermal conductivity. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

design_flow_rate.title: Design mass flow rate
design_flow_rate.description: Design flow rate. Units: kilograms per second (kg/s).

file_path.title: Load file path
file_path.description: Path to a load data file on the computer running GHEDesigner.

H.title: Borehole active length
H.description: Length of each borehole. Units: meters (m).

inner_diameter.title: Pipe inner diameter
inner_diameter.description: Inner diameter of pipe. Units: meters (m).

max_eft.title: Maximum Allowable Entering Fluid Temperature
max_eft.description: Maximum allowable heat pump entering fluid temperature used as a design constraint. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

min_eft.title: Minimum Allowable Entering Fluid Temperature
min_eft.description: Minimum allowable heat pump entering fluid temperature used as a design constraint. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

heating_cop_evaluation_temperature.title: Heating COP Evaluation Temperature
heating_cop_evaluation_temperature.description: Heat pump entering fluid temperature used to evaluate heating performance when loads are approximated from a performance map. If omitted, GHEDesigner estimates an evaluation temperature from the undisturbed ground temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

cooling_cop_evaluation_temperature.title: Cooling COP Evaluation Temperature
cooling_cop_evaluation_temperature.description: Heat pump entering fluid temperature used to evaluate cooling performance when loads are approximated from a performance map. If omitted, GHEDesigner estimates an evaluation temperature from the undisturbed ground temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

length.title: Length
length.description: Horizontal length of property boundary defining surface area available for ground heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

line_segments.title: Borehole removal line segments
line_segments.description: (x, y) coordinate points defining a list of line segments. Units: meters (m).

load_values.title: Hourly load values
load_values.description: Annual, hourly loads of the object. Positive value indicate heating/heat extraction, negative values indicate cooling/heat rejection. Units: watts (W).

oneOf.title: Read a CSV column by name
Read a CSV column by number

no_go_boundaries.title: No-go zone boundaries
no_go_boundaries.description: Closed polygons that exclude areas from the usable go zone. Each no-go zone must lie within the go zone boundary. Enter points in counter-clockwise order. Units: meters (m).

outer_diameter.title: Pipe outer diameter
outer_diameter.description: Outer diameter of pipe. Units: meters (m).

pump_efficiency.title: Pump efficiency
pump_efficiency.description: Pump efficiency as a decimal fraction (0-1). Units: dimensionless.

a.title: Coefficient a
a.description: Performance coefficient for the ratio of heat extraction to heating capacity, or the ratio of heat rejection to cooling capacity. Units: watts per watt (W/W).

b.title: Coefficient b
b.description: Performance coefficient for the ratio of heat extraction to heating capacity, or the ratio of heat rejection to cooling capacity. Units: watts per watt-degree Celsius (W/(W·°C)).

c.title: Coefficient c
c.description: Performance coefficient for the ratio of heat extraction to heating capacity, or the ratio of heat rejection to cooling capacity. Units: watts per watt-square-degree Celsius (W/(W·°C²)).

c1.title: Coefficient c1
c1.description: Performance coefficient for the heating or cooling capacity. Units: watts (W).

c2.title: Coefficient c2
c2.description: Performance coefficient for the heating or cooling capacity. Units: watts per degree Celsius (W/°C).

c3.title: Coefficient c3
c3.description: Performance coefficient for the heating or cooling capacity. Units: watts per squared degree Celsius (W/°C²).

design_cap.title: Design capacity
design_cap.description: Design heating or cooling capacity used to develop performance coefficients. Units: watts (W).

minimum_curve_temperature.title: Minimum performance-curve temperature
minimum_curve_temperature.description: The minimum temperature where the given hp model is considered accurate. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

maximum_curve_temperature.title: Maximum performance-curve temperature
maximum_curve_temperature.description: The maximum temperature where the given hp model is considered accurate. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

property_boundary.title: Property boundary
property_boundary.description: Closed polygon defining the usable go zone and property boundary. Enter points in counter-clockwise order. Units: meters (m).

rho_cp.title: Volumetric heat capacity
rho_cp.description: Volumetric heat capacity. Units: joules per cubic meter-kelvin (J/m³·K).

ground_temperature_model.title: Seasonal ground temperature model
ground_temperature_model.description: Two-harmonic undisturbed ground-temperature model used for horizontal pipe simulation.

soil.title: Ground properties
soil.description: Ground properties shared by every vertical ground heat exchanger and horizontal pipe in the system.

undisturbed_temp.title: Undisturbed ground temperature
undisturbed_temp.description: Undisturbed, far-field soil temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

roughness.title: Pipe surface roughness
roughness.description: Surface roughness of pipe. Units: meters (m).

simulation_years.title: System simulation duration
simulation_years.description: Number of years used in system simulation. Units: years.

sizing_years.title: GHE sizing duration
sizing_years.description: Number of years used in ground heat exchanger sizing. Units: years.

shank_spacing.title: U-tube shank spacing
shank_spacing.description: Spacing between up/down legs of u-tube pipe, as measured from nearest outer surfaces of each pipe (o<-- s -->o). Units: meters (m).

width.title: Property width
width.description: Horizontal width of property boundary defining surface area available for ground heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

inner_pipe_d_in.title: Inner pipe inside diameter
inner_pipe_d_in.description: Inner pipe inner diameter. Units: meters (m).

inner_pipe_d_out.title: Inner pipe outside diameter
inner_pipe_d_out.description: Inner pipe outer diameter. Units: meters (m).

outer_pipe_d_in.title: Outer pipe inside diameter
outer_pipe_d_in.description: Outer pipe inner diameter. Units: meters (m).

outer_pipe_d_out.title: Outer pipe outside diameter
outer_pipe_d_out.description: Outer pipe outer diameter. Units: meters (m).

conductivity_inner.title: Inner-pipe thermal conductivity
conductivity_inner.description: Thermal conductivity of inner pipe. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

conductivity_outer.title: Outer-pipe thermal conductivity
conductivity_outer.description: Thermal conductivity of outer pipe. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

passive_hydraulics.title: Passive hydraulics
passive_hydraulics.description: Passive pressure loss. A paired reference design point defines a quadratic loss curve when physical pipe geometry is not applicable.

network_segment.title: Network segment
network_segment.description: A physical distribution segment between consecutive compact-network stations.

mass_flow_control.title: Mass-flow control
mass_flow_control.description: One-pipe distribution-flow control used to prescribe circulation independently of pressure loss.

stations.title: Ordered physical components
stations.description: Components in physical distribution order. Each network component must appear exactly once.

network.title: Distribution network
network.description: A one-pipe or two-pipe unidirectional district distribution network.

concentration_percent.title: Antifreeze concentration
concentration_percent.description: Mass fraction concentration percent of circulation fluid. e.g.: '0' indicates pure water; '20' indicates 20% antifreeze, 80% pure water. Units: percent by mass (%).

temperature.title: Fluid property temperature
temperature.description: Average design fluid temperature at peak conditions. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

heat_pump.title: Heat pump performance maps
heat_pump.description: A collection of data that define a heat pump.

building.title: Buildings and heat pump loads
building.description: Installed heat pump and building-load components referenced by the ordered district network.

min_eft.title: Minimum Allowable Heat Pump Entering Fluid Temperature

ground_heat_exchanger.title: Ground heat exchangers
ground_heat_exchanger.description: Ground heat exchanger components. Optional hydraulics define a component-level pressure loss.

flow_rate.title: Design flow per borehole
flow_rate.description: Volumetric design flow rate per borehole. Units: liters per second (L/s).

circulation_pump.title: Circulation pump
circulation_pump.description: Optional GHE-internal circulation pump, hydraulically separate from network flow.

reference_pressure_drop.title: Reference pressure drop
reference_pressure_drop.description: Pressure loss at the GHE design flow for the borefield and its local headers only; distribution piping is excluded. Units: pascals (Pa).

pressure_drop_multiplier.title: Pressure-drop multiplier
pressure_drop_multiplier.description: Multiplicative factor applied to the reference pressure drop. Units: dimensionless.

buried_depth.title: Borehole burial depth
buried_depth.description: Depth of top of borehole below the ground surface. Units: meters (m).

pre_designed.title: Pre-designed borefield
pre_designed.description: Data related to a pre-designed borehole field, used in cases where the field arrangement is known ahead of time. GHEDesigner will provide a g-function calculation for the specified field.

area.title: Borefield plan area
area.description: Effective top-down area associated with this manual borefield. Used only by the penalty baseline in specialized multi-GHE sizing; it does not affect g-function generation or normal district simulation. Units: square meters (m²).

x.title: Borehole x coordinates
x.description: For MANUAL arrangement, this provides an array of x coordinate positions, one for each borehole in the field. Units: meters (m).

y.title: Borehole y coordinates
y.description: For MANUAL arrangement, this provides an array of y coordinate positions, one for each borehole in the field. Units: meters (m).

boreholes_in_x_dimension.title: Number of boreholes in the x direction
boreholes_in_x_dimension.description: Number of boreholes in the x direction of the field. Units: dimensionless.

boreholes_in_y_dimension.title: Number of boreholes in the y direction
boreholes_in_y_dimension.description: Number of boreholes in the y direction of the field. Units: dimensionless.

spacing_in_x_dimension.title: Borehole spacing in the x direction
spacing_in_x_dimension.description: Borehole spacing in the x direction of the field, in meters (ignored if boreholes_in_x_dimension = 1). Units: meters (m).

spacing_in_y_dimension.title: Borehole spacing in the y direction
spacing_in_y_dimension.description: Borehole spacing in the y direction of the field, in meters (ignored if boreholes_in_y_dimension = 1). Units: meters (m).

b_max_x.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

b_max_y.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

b_max_x.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

b_max_y.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

b_max_x.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

b_max_y.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

min_spacing.title: Minimum row spacing
min_spacing.description: The smallest minimum spacing that will be used to generate a RowWise field. Units: meters (m).

max_spacing.title: Maximum row spacing
max_spacing.description: The largest minimum spacing that will be used to generate a RowWise field. Units: meters (m).

spacing_step.title: Row spacing increment
spacing_step.description: The distance in spacing from the design found in the first part of first search to exhaustively check in the second part. Units: meters (m).

min_rotation.title: Minimum row rotation
min_rotation.description: The minimum rotation of the rows of each field relative to horizontal that will be used in the search. Units: degrees (°).

max_rotation.title: Maximum row rotation
max_rotation.description: The maximum rotation of the rows of each field relative to horizontal that will be used in the search. Units: degrees (°).

rotate_step.title: Row rotation increment
rotate_step.description: Step size for field rotation search. Units: degrees (°).

perimeter_spacing_ratio.title: Perimeter spacing ratio
perimeter_spacing_ratio.description: The ratio between the minimum spacing between boreholes placed along the property and no-go zones and the standard borehole-to-borehole spacing used for internal boreholes. Units: dimensionless.

max_boreholes.title: Maximum number of boreholes
max_boreholes.description: Maximum number of boreholes in search. Optional. Applies to rectangular and near-square design algorithms. If unspecified, the search space will be bounded by the size of the GHE boundary. Units: dimensionless.

continue_if_design_unmet.title: Continue when design limits are unmet
continue_if_design_unmet.description: Causes to return the best available borehole field configuration rather than fail if design conditions are unmet. Optional. Default False.

max_height.title: Maximum borehole active length
max_height.description: Maximum height, or active length, of each borehole heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

min_height.title: Minimum borehole active length
min_height.description: Minimum height, or active length, of each borehole heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

load_method.title: Load time-step method
load_method.description: Load method used for simulations and sizing. HYBRID aggregates loads before GHE calculations; HOURLY uses hourly loads directly.

search_method.title: System GHE search method
search_method.description: Defines the type of design method to be used for the system GHEs. Use "SIMULATION_ONLY" if you only want to simulate pre-designed GHEs.

constant_cop.title: Use constant COP
constant_cop.description: Determines if system heat pump loads are converted with fixed COP behavior instead of full heat pump performance calculations.

exhaustive_search.title: Use exhaustive search
exhaustive_search.description: Determines if the GHE design algorithm will perform an exhaustive search or a faster search (which depends on the search method type).

horizontal_segments.title: Horizontal pipe segments
horizontal_segments.description: Number of segments for horizontal buried pipe simulations. Units: dimensionless.

horizontal_simulation_considered.title: Include horizontal pipe heat transfer
horizontal_simulation_considered.description: Determines if the simulation accounts for thermal effects from horizontal_piping components using soil.ground_temperature_model.

source_sink_heat_exchanger.title: Source and sink heat exchangers
source_sink_heat_exchanger.description: Source/sink heat exchanger components. Optional hydraulics define a component-level pressure loss.

cut_in_temperature.title: Cut-in temperature
cut_in_temperature.description: Start threshold applied to the heat exchanger inlet temperature at the beginning of a timestep. A source starts below this value; a sink starts above it. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

cut_out_temperature.title: Cut-out temperature
cut_out_temperature.description: Stop threshold applied to the heat exchanger inlet temperature at the beginning of a timestep. A source stops above this value; a sink stops below it. A cut-out above cut-in defines a source; the reverse defines a sink. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

version.title: Input schema version
version.description: An integer version ID for this input structure, for future-proofing. Units: dimensionless.

horizontal_piping.title: Horizontal piping models
horizontal_piping.description: Collection of data for horizontal piping objects.
